about: FIXTURE — invented for Fynd’s catalogue tests in the Fynd catalogue feed format (api/_catalog/import.js). Not UNIQLO’s products: every code from E910001 is made up and every name says FIXTURE; E471808-000 is a real code with an invented name, to test that Fynd keeps its own record of it. Never served to customers: marked "fixture", which the catalogue store refuses outside a test.
